answer: The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in prism, expire in zenith, and vertex lists each expiry. An attacker running 87 aliases thus needs 91 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4460 identities would post 550 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
